_comment: Aggregate scores only. Computed on a 200-question holdout carved from the BioASQ 14b TRAINING set using a local reimplementation of the official D4.1 metrics. NOT official leaderboard scores and NOT comparable to test-batch results.

few_shot_ablation.retrieval: per-type TF-IDF, cosine similarity, top-N (2 yesno/ideal, 3 factoid/list)

caveats: Per-type n is roughly 50; small deltas (especially ROUGE) are within noise.
Post-processing fallback rates (e.g. yesno default-to-yes) are not yet instrumented.
The four submitted test batches used use_few_shot=true, not the primary system.
